skillsSummary: 2. Promote ethical work practices and values

criteria: 1.1 Personal vision, mission and goals are formulated based on potential and concerning organization objectives and strategic plan
1.2 Self-esteem and a positive self-image are developed and maintained based on value
1.3 Emotional intelligence and stress management are demonstrated as per workplace requirements.
1.4 Assertiveness is developed and maintained based on the requirements of the job.
1.5 Accountability and responsibility for one's actions are demonstrated based on workplace instructions.
1.6 Time management, attendance and punctuality are observed as per the organization’s policy.
1.7 Personal goals are managed as per the organization’s objective
1.8 Self-strengths and weaknesses are identified based on personal objectives
1.9 Motivation, initiative and proactivity are utilized as per the organization policy
1.10 Individual performance is evaluated and monitored according to the agreed targets.

elementsAndPerformanceCriteria.elementTitle: 2. Promote ethical work practices and values
criteria: 2.1 Integrity is demonstrated as per acceptable norms
2.2 Codes of conduct is applied as per the workplace requirements
2.3 Policies and guidelines are observed as per the workplace requirements
2.4 Professionalism is exercised in line with organizational policies
3.1 Teams are formed to enhance productivity based on organization’s objectives
3.2 Duties are assigned to teams under the organization policy.
3.3 Team activities are managed and coordinated as per set objectives.
3.4 Team performance is evaluated based on set targets as per workplace policy.
3.5 Conflicts are resolved between team members in line with organization policy.
3.6 Gender and diversity-related issues are identified and mainstreamed in accordance with workplace policy.
3.7 Healthy relationships are developed and maintained in line with the workplace.
3.8 Adaptability and flexibility are applied in dealing with team members as per workplace policies
4.1 Personal growth and development needs are identified and assessed in line with the requirements of the job.
4.2 Training and career opportunities are identified and utilized based on job requirements.
4.3 Resources for training are mobilized and allocated based on organizations and individual skills needs.
4.4 Licenses and certifications relevant to the job and career are obtained and renewed as per policy.
4.5 Recognitions are sought as proof of career advancement in line with professional requirements.
4.6 Work priorities and personal commitments are balanced and managed based on the requirements of the job and personal objectives.
4.7 Dynamism and on-the-job learning are embraced in line with the organization’s goals and objectives.
5.1 Creative, innovative and practical solutions are developed based on the problem
5.2 Independence and initiative in identifying and solving problems are demonstrated based on the requirements of the job.
5.3 Team problems are solved as per the workplace guidelines
5.4 Problem-solving strategies are applied as per the workplace guidelines
5.5 Problems are analysed and assumptions tested as per the context of data and circumstances
6.1 Customers' needs are identified based on their characteristics
6.2 Customer feedback is allowed and
6.3 Facilitated in line with organization policies.
6.4 Customer concerns and complaints are analyzed and resolved in line with the set organizational culture.
6.5 Proactive customer outreach programs are implemented as per organizational policies
6.6 Customer retention strategies are developed and implemented in line with the organizational policy

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to:
a. Apply emotional intelligence and stress management techniques as per workplace requirements.
b. Formulate personal vision, mission, and goals based on potential and organizational objectives.
c. Maintain a positive self-image and self-esteem based on values.
trainerActivities: - Facilitate an Interactive Lecture on self-awareness and the importance of personal vision, mission, and goals, using real-world examples.
- Conduct a Group Discussion on emotional intelligence and stress management strategies, prompting trainees to share personal experiences and coping mechanisms.
traineeActivities: - Participate actively in the Interactive Lecture, taking notes and contributing to the discussion on self-awareness and goal formulation.
- Engage in the Group Discussion, sharing experiences related to emotional intelligence and stress, and identifying effective management strategies.
Assignment: Develop a personal vision and mission statement, and set three short-term professional goals.
resourcesAndRefs: Course manual, projector, whiteboard, markers, relevant case studies.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to:
a. Develop and maintain assertiveness according to job requirements.
b. Observe time management, attendance, and punctuality as per organizational policy.
c. Set, monitor, and evaluate individual performance targets effectively.
trainerActivities: - Lead an Interactive Lecture on time management techniques and the importance of punctuality and attendance in the workplace.
- Organize a Case Study analysis on scenarios requiring assertiveness versus aggressiveness, guiding trainees to identify appropriate responses.
traineeActivities: - Actively participate in the Interactive Lecture, discussing personal time management challenges and proposing solutions.
- Analyze the provided Case Study in groups, then present and justify their solutions regarding assertiveness in professional contexts.
Assignment: Create a weekly schedule demonstrating effective time management principles and submit a reflective journal entry on applying assertiveness in a hypothetical work situation.
resourcesAndRefs: Course manual, time management tools/templates, case studies on workplace assertiveness.

schedule.sessionTitle: Promoting Ethical Work Practices and Values - Part 1
learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to:
a. Demonstrate integrity as per acceptable norms.
b. Exercise professionalism in line with organizational policies.
c. Understand core values, ethics, and beliefs relevant to the workplace.
trainerActivities: - Facilitate a Think-Pair-Share activity focusing on different ethical dilemmas commonly found in the workplace, prompting trainees to discuss potential solutions.
- Lead an Interactive Lecture on the concept of professionalism, core values, and their importance in maintaining a positive work environment.
traineeActivities: - Participate in the Think-Pair-Share, discussing ethical dilemmas with a partner and sharing their perspectives with the larger group.
- Engage in the Interactive Lecture, taking notes and asking clarifying questions about professionalism and workplace values.
Assignment: Research and present three examples of ethical conduct in their desired profession.
resourcesAndRefs: Course manual, ethical dilemma scenarios, examples of professional codes of conduct.

schedule.sessionTitle: Promoting Ethical Work Practices and Values - Part 2
learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to:
a. Apply organizational codes of conduct in daily work practices.
b. Observe industry policies and procedures in all professional activities.
c. Recognize the significance of patriotism within a professional context.
trainerActivities: - Coordinate a Group Discussion on various organizational codes of conduct and industry-specific policies, encouraging trainees to analyze their practical implications.
- Deliver an Interactive Lecture on understanding and applying company policies and procedures, including the role of patriotism in organizational culture.
traineeActivities: - Actively participate in the Group Discussion, sharing insights on how codes of conduct and policies affect day-to-day operations.
- Engage in the Interactive Lecture, taking notes and participating in Q&A sessions regarding policy application and compliance.
Assignment: Develop a short presentation outlining a specific company policy and its importance, as well as how patriotism can be demonstrated in the workplace.
resourcesAndRefs: Course manual, examples of company policies and procedures, industry standards documents.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to:
a. Form effective teams to enhance productivity based on organizational objectives.
b. Manage and coordinate team activities to achieve set objectives.
c. Resolve conflicts among team members in line with organizational policy.
trainerActivities: - Facilitate a Group Activity where trainees are assigned to form teams and given a task to complete, demonstrating team building and coordination.
- Lead a Case Study analysis on common team conflicts, guiding trainees to identify conflict resolution strategies and apply them.
traineeActivities: - Participate actively in the Group Activity, collaborating with team members to complete the assigned task and reflecting on team dynamics.
- Analyze the provided Case Study in groups, then present their proposed conflict resolution approaches and their rationale.
Assignment: Reflect on a team experience (real or simulated) and write a report detailing team dynamics, challenges faced, and conflict resolution methods used.
resourcesAndRefs: Course manual, team-building exercises, conflict resolution models, case studies on team dynamics.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to:
a. Identify and assess personal growth and development needs relevant to job requirements.
b. Obtain and renew licenses and certifications pertinent to career advancement.
c. Utilize training and career opportunities based on job requirements.
trainerActivities: - Deliver an Interactive Lecture on identifying personal and professional development needs, including avenues for growth and recognizing career advancement.
- Conduct a 'Give One Take One' activity where trainees share and gather information on various training programs, certifications, and resources available for professional growth.
traineeActivities: - Engage in the Interactive Lecture, taking notes and participating in discussions about personal development plans.
- Participate in the 'Give One Take One' activity, sharing information on development resources they know and collecting new information from peers.
Assignment: Create a personal development plan for the next 1-3 years, including identified training needs and desired certifications.
resourcesAndRefs: Course manual, career development guides, examples of professional certifications, 'Give One Take One' templates.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to:
a. Analyze problems and test assumptions as per the context of data and circumstances.
b. Develop creative, innovative, and practical solutions based on identified problems.
c. Demonstrate independence and initiative in identifying and solving problems.
trainerActivities: - Present a real-world business problem as a Case Study, guiding trainees through a structured problem-solving process (e.g., define, analyze, generate solutions, evaluate, implement).
- Facilitate a Brainstorming session to encourage trainees to generate innovative and creative solutions for various hypothetical workplace challenges.
traineeActivities: - Work in groups to analyze the Case Study, apply problem-solving steps, and present their proposed solutions.
- Participate actively in the Brainstorming session, contributing diverse ideas and building upon suggestions from peers to find solutions.
Assignment: Identify a problem in their personal or academic life, apply a structured problem-solving approach, and document the process and solution.
resourcesAndRefs: Course manual, problem-solving frameworks (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone diagram), creative thinking tools, case studies.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to:
a. Identify customer needs based on their characteristics.
b. Resolve customer concerns and complaints in line with organizational culture.
c. Implement proactive customer outreach programs and retention strategies.
trainerActivities: - Facilitate a Role Play exercise where trainees practice identifying customer needs and handling complaints in various scenarios.
- Lead an Interactive Lecture on customer feedback methods, customer retention strategies, and the importance of proactive customer outreach.
traineeActivities: - Participate in the Role Play, taking on both customer and service provider roles, and reflecting on their performance in identifying needs and resolving issues.
- Engage in the Interactive Lecture, taking notes and discussing best practices for customer care and retention.
Assignment: Develop a simple customer feedback form and outline three strategies for improving customer retention for a hypothetical business.
resourcesAndRefs: Course manual, customer service scenarios, examples of customer feedback forms, customer retention strategies.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the session, the trainee should be able to:
a. Analyze complex workplace scenarios applying principles of work ethics and practices.
b. Synthesize knowledge from all learning outcomes to propose integrated solutions for organizational challenges.
c. Evaluate the interconnectedness of self-management, teamwork, and customer care in fostering a positive work environment.
trainerActivities: - Organize a comprehensive Case Study integrating elements from all previously covered learning outcomes (self-management, ethics, teamwork, problem-solving, customer care).
- Facilitate a 'Gallery Walk' where groups present their solutions to the integrated case study, and other trainees provide feedback and ask questions.
traineeActivities: - Work in expert groups to analyze the integrated Case Study, developing and documenting a holistic solution addressing all relevant aspects.
- Participate in the 'Gallery Walk,' presenting their group's solution, and actively reviewing and providing constructive feedback on other groups' work.
Assignment: Prepare a final portfolio piece reflecting on the most impactful learning from the unit and how it applies to their career aspirations.
resourcesAndRefs: Course manual, complex case studies, presentation materials for Gallery Walk.
